title: Constructing Balance from Imbalance for Long-tailed Image Recognition
reasoning: The paper focuses on addressing 'head-to-tail bias' and 'data imbalance' in long-tailed image recognition, which refers to statistical bias in data distribution, not ethical or moral bias. There is no discussion or evaluation of religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics in the context of the model or its applications.
